periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree diagonal tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis, oriented downwards toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ellipsoid/oval with a length approximately 1.5 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering with the centroid shifted towards the superior-lateral quadrant.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band, approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap distance approximately equal to the horizontal width of a single pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct chromatic gradient from off-white/yellowish on the cranial fur to bright white on the dorsal region.
